Introduction. Resin is dropped by Greyling, Greydwarf, Greydwarf shaman, Greydwarf brute, and Kvastur. It has a chance of dropping from all trees except for Ancient Trees and Scorched Trees, and can be occasionally found in Chest in the Meadows.
